purpose: Measure whether seed-level median Oracle labels are stable enough to evaluate the unchanged deployment-scoped optimizer.
oracle_rule: A candidate is removed only when a paired seed-clustered confidence interval proves it more than 3% slower than another candidate.

predeclared_interpretation.few_unstable_families: Rerun only ambiguous or severe families with isolated complete permutations.
predeclared_interpretation.many_unstable_families: Replace seed-level median evaluation with an isolated family-specific calibration protocol before further optimizer tuning.
predeclared_interpretation.model_confidence_misses: Inspect only confidence-authorized misses; do not tune against inconclusive labels.

boundaries: The candidate-specific optimizer is not retrained.
The original failed maximum-regret gate remains frozen as failed.
This consumed development matrix is not final holdout evidence.
